tests.name: 官方验证视图契约：缺帧/图片错误/断连/不确定动作只等待新帧且不重发

checks: Automatic new UUID poll with delayed JPEG preserves local masked input focus and length before and after image load
Only local temporary typing is enabled on an available unconsumed connected frame; official click, Enter and submit remain disabled until the new image loads
Submitting still consumes the UUID and clears input immediately; stale frames cannot replay actions
Disconnect disables and clears input; leaving verification removes it and remount starts empty
Uncertain responses are not replayed or reflected; test and public metadata contain no input values
boundary: Only the existing affected privacy case was rerun after separating local temporary input eligibility from official action eligibility. Earlier 4-case and 1-case runs retain their original build identities; no full-suite or real official verification claim is made.
